I couldn't find a justfile in this checkout, so I can't tell you the name of the fast-test recipe. The `Makefile` is also still there on `main`, so the switch may not be merged into this copy yet.

The old `test-fast` target ran this, and you can run it directly:

```sh
python -m pytest -m "not postgres and not integration" -q
```

It skips the Postgres and network integration tests. The full suite (`pytest -q`) needs `docker compose up db` running first.

To find the fast recipe in your justfile, run `just --list`. If there isn't one, you could add:

```just
test-fast:
    python -m pytest -m "not postgres and not integration" -q
```
